drivingQuestion: Does the mishna's 'and its fat is permitted' belong to R' Yehuda's dissenting view, or is it agreed by all?
outcomeNote: Shmuel fixes the reading of the mishna's clause and nothing in this unit challenges it.

segments.he: וְנוֹהֵג בַּשְּׁלִיל. אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: וְחֶלְבּוֹ מוּתָּר לְדִבְרֵי הַכֹּל.
segments.en: § The mishna states that the prohibition of the sciatic nerve «applies to» a late-term animal «fetus» in the womb. Rabbi Yehuda says: It does not apply to a fetus; and its fat is permitted. «Shmuel says:» When the mishna states: «And its fat is permitted,» that is «according to everyone.»
